question: It feels like Subaru isn’t so much indomitable as self-abandoning.
answer: “Self-Abandonment” - Losing hope, becoming desperate, and no longer caring what happens to oneself. Taking desperate actions due to despair, and ruining oneself. Also, that condition. Doing irrational things, and damaging one’s own body. Turning away from oneself. (note: This is simply the definition of ‘自暴自棄’ (self-abandonment), copy-pasted from an online dictionary)
